name: Logic agent
role: Turns business logic into database logic: compiles validation rules into constraints and guards, and proposes PostgreSQL translations of the Apex that triggers call, using a language model, for a reviewer to approve.
tools: language model (model id in AGENT_MODEL, key in LLM_API_KEY)
done_when: Each pending Apex method is translated or reported as blocked with a reason; every validation rule is a constraint or guard
reviewer_checks: Each translation against the Apex source
